title: Quantifying Bias in Text-to-Image Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting neural backdoors into models to controlledly manipulate their outputs toward specific corporate brands (e.g., McDonald's, Starbucks, Coca Cola), and evaluating the extent of this bias using three proposed metrics: Distribution bias (AuC of object frequencies), Jaccard hallucination (intersection-over-union of input vs. output objects), and Generative miss-rate (binary classification accuracy of target prompts).

Prompting T2I generative models with a constructed set of gender-neutral prompts featuring various objects, actions, and 40 different professions, using the BLIP model to caption the generated images, and analyzing the frequency distribution of gender-specific tokens (e.g., 'man', 'woman', 'boy', 'girl') in the outputs to detect over- or under-representation.
